References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.note: Lab test (Daniele 2026-09-27): the vat fills the whole platform and units leave / enter straight from the deck's rim (no front door). Compare with D-13.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.name: Knot
References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.note: XS, 9 platforms, choke, inward. The axis switch (Forge, review 2026-09-29: was a rotor) holds the map together: its two fixed decks go up to the pockets a / a', and its switched bridges connect either the middle road (m / m', state 1) and the axis platforms above and below (u / w, state 2), so whoever fires it decides whether the middle road crosses. Survivor ring: everything but the homes.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.name: Drawbridge Cross
References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.note: XS, 10 platforms, choke, inward. Both axis platforms are retract relays (review 2026-09-29: the bottom too). The top one: its two bridges down to the left and right pockets are drawbridges (two decks - a commitment), so firing it cuts the top lane in one go and the fight moves through the middle platforms and the bottom axis. Survivor ring: everything but the homes.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.name: Hex Switch
References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.note: M, 15 platforms, open, inward. A hexagon of platforms round a 6-bridge switch hub (Forge): state 1 bridges the bottom centre and the two top sides, state 2 the top centre and the two bottom sides (review 2026-09-29), so every fire moves all three roads into the hub. The hub has no fixed deck; its bridges hold it in every state (a relay hub). Braided pockets outside. Survivor ring: the hub and the hexagon.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.name: Console
References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.note: M, 17 platforms, choke, outward. A king-of-the-hill map: the T4 hill sits on the axis between the two crossings. Each home keeps a remote console (k) one deck away; it raises that side's two shortcuts from the mid platform m up to u and down to w - a home-side console driving a central advantage. The hill falls at the Last Stand; the rim with the consoles and both crossings survives.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.name: Switchyard
References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.note: M, 15 platforms, choke, inward. Two lanes on each side meet a 6-way switch on the axis (fixed decks to m / m', a switched bridge up to the top gate u or down to the bottom gate w). The top and bottom axis platforms are gates now (review 2026-09-29: relays were easy to avoid): each draws up its two lane bridges, and its fixed decks go down to the mid platforms. Every crossing of the axis is a relay.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.name: Ring Road
References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.note: L, 19 platforms, open, inward, 2v2. A ring road runs round the map; teammates share k. The centre is a rotor hub: its pair of bridges turns from the middle road (m / m') to the axis (t / z), and it has no fixed deck. The bottom diagonal platforms beside it are gates (review 2026-09-29: always some risk near the centre): each draws up its bridge into the hub (a gate on the top diagonals would face the camera, rule G09; they keep no bridge into the hub, which leaves the hub's relay button a free 90-degree slot above it, rule G11). Survivor ring: everything inside the ring road.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.name: Rim Run
References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.note: L, 18 platforms, open, both finales. A rim ring round a T4 hill, crossing the axis on top (t) and at the bottom twice (z, y). In the core m is a retract relay: its decks into the hill and up to u retract. On the rim each pocket a is a remote console driving the FAR side's bottom shortcut w'-z (a home-side console, a central advantage). Outward: the rim survives with the consoles; inward: the hill, k / k' and m / m' survive with the retract.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.name: Descent
References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.note: L, 19 platforms, choke, inward, three rings. The homes and pockets fall first, then the middle lanes, leaving the centre. The centre is now a rotor hub with no fixed deck (a meat grinder: its pair turns from the middle road to the axis and back, killing whatever is on it), and the bottom diagonal platforms q are gates drawing up their bridge into the hub (review 2026-09-29: experts dodged the old rotor).

References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.name: Grinder
References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.note: S, 13 platforms, choke, inward. A 6-way meat grinder: a hexagon of platforms round a rotor hub whose three bridges (120 degrees apart) turn 60 degrees every fire - bottom centre + top sides, then top centre + bottom sides - so the hub is always connected and every turn kills whatever is on its bridges (review 2026-09-29; short bridges so the hexagon fits). Two lanes per side feed the hexagon. Survivor ring: the hub and the hexagon.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.name: Hill
References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.note: M, 15 platforms, choke, inward. A T4 hill on the axis. Each side's mid platform m is a retract relay: its deck into the hill and its deck back to the pocket a retract (a commitment on the main road). The top axis platform t is a remote console that raises the mid-to-bottom shortcuts m-w on both sides (a central console driving the approaches). Survivor ring: the hill, the axis platforms, u / w and m / m'.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.name: Round
References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.note: S, 13 platforms, open, inward. A round ring of four platforms on the hub's diagonals, joined by curved quarter arcs, circles a 4-way grinder hub (a rotor with no fixed deck: its pair of bridges turns from one diagonal to the other, killing what is on it). Each home's two pockets land on the ring's near side; a high platform over the top pocket drops onto the ring too. Point-symmetric. Survivor ring: the hub and the ring.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.name: Whirl
References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.note: XS, 9 platforms, open, inward. The smallest ring: four platforms on the hub's diagonals, joined by curved quarter arcs round a switch hub (no fixed deck: its bridges reach one diagonal or the other). Each home sits off the ring's bottom-left platform and swings up to its pocket on a long C-shaped bridge of Curve_45s; the pocket drops onto the ring's top-left platform. Point-symmetric: a whirlpool. Survivor ring: the hub and the ring.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.name: Crescent
References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.note: M, 17 platforms, choke, outward. King of the hill with the hill in the middle between a top and a bottom crossing. Each home keeps a remote console one deck away that raises its side's two shortcuts from the middle platform up and down to the rim (a home-side console, a central advantage). The pockets climb to the rim on curved bridges (Curve_45). The hill falls first at the Last Stand; the rim with the consoles survives. Point-symmetric.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.name: Hooks
References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.note: XS, 9 platforms, choke, inward. A 4-way grinder hub (a rotor with no fixed deck) on the diagonals; each diagonal platform throws a Curve_90 hook back to the home side - the top one to the home, the bottom one to its pocket - and a long straight to the far side's platform. Point-symmetric. Survivor ring: the hub and its four platforms.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.name: Round Table
References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.note: M, 17 platforms, open, inward, 2v2. The round ring of N-11 (four platforms on curved quarter arcs round a 4-way grinder hub) with two homes per side sharing a platform between them; each home's pocket lands on the ring, and a high platform over the top pocket drops onto it too. Point-symmetric. Survivor ring: the hub and the ring.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.name: Galaxy
References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.note: M, 15 platforms, choke, inward. Two spiral arms: from each home a long bridge rises and hooks round (two Curve_45s) into the centre from the side. The centre is a switch whose bridges reach the top and bottom platforms (state 1) or the two diagonal platforms (state 2); the arms are fixed. Each home also has a long deck to the far crossing platform - the second lane. Point-symmetric: the arms read as a two-armed galaxy. Survivor ring: the switch and its four platforms.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.name: Whirlpool
References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.note: M, 17 platforms, open, inward. The round ring (curved quarter arcs round a 4-way grinder hub) inside a full rim: each pocket lands on the ring, a high platform drops onto it too, and the rim crosses the map at the very top and bottom. Point-symmetric. Survivor ring: the hub and the ring.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.name: Side Hairpins
References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.note: M, 15 platforms, choke, inward. Behind each home its two pockets are joined by a wide hairpin (a U of four Curve_45s bulging out at the map's edge - the slow back road). The pockets climb on curved bridges to the rim, which crosses at the top and bottom; the middle is a switch hub whose bridges reach the middle platforms or the rim crossings. Point-symmetric. Survivor ring: the hub, the middle platforms and the crossings.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.name: Knotwork
References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.note: M, 16 platforms, choke, outward. An X junction knots the middle: its four bridges run to the middle platforms and the top and bottom crossings. Each home's remote console raises its side's shortcuts from the middle platform to the rim; the pockets climb to the rim on curved bridges. At the Last Stand the knot falls first and the rim survives with the consoles. Point-symmetric.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.name: S-Bends
References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.note: S, 11 platforms, choke, inward. Every lane is an S-bend: from each home's two pockets a bridge snakes (Curve_45 one way then the other) onto the switch hub's top-left and bottom-left platforms; long straights cross from those to the far side. The pockets behind the home are joined by a hairpin. The hub's bridges pick one diagonal or the other. Point-symmetric. Survivor ring: the hub and its four platforms.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.name: Roundabout
References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.note: L, 20 platforms, open, outward. A six-way deck roundabout (Junction_Hub6) in the middle feeds a hexagon of platforms; the rim runs round it with a crossing at the very top and bottom. The hexagon's west and east platforms are gates: each draws up its spoke into the roundabout and its bridge to the home's middle platform. At the Last Stand the roundabout falls first; the hexagon and the rim fight on round the gates. Point-symmetric.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.name: Hex Gates
References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.note: M, 14 platforms, open, inward. The six-way roundabout (Junction_Hub6) inside a hexagon of platforms; the upper-left and lower-right hexagon platforms are gates that draw up their spoke into the roundabout and their hexagon edge in one go. Each home reaches the hexagon straight and through both pockets. Point-symmetric. Survivor ring: the roundabout and the hexagon.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.name: Crossroads
References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.note: M, 15 platforms, open, inward. The middle lane runs through two X junctions, one each side of a switch hub: every X splits the lane up to a high platform, down to a low one and on into the hub, whose bridges reach the two X junctions or the top and bottom platforms. Point-symmetric. Survivor ring: the hub, the top and bottom platforms and the high / low platforms by the X junctions.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.name: K Crossing
References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.note: L, 18 platforms, choke, outward. A K junction knots the middle: its four diagonal bridges run to the platforms above-left, below-left and their twins. Each home's remote console raises shortcuts from its middle platform up and down to the rim. The K and its platforms fall first at the Last Stand; the rim survives with the consoles. Point-symmetric.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.name: Y Ring
References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.note: S, 13 platforms, choke, inward. The round ring of curved quarter arcs round a 4-way grinder hub (N-11), reached through Y junctions: each home's front bridge splits (60 degrees each way) to both pockets, which land on the ring. Point-symmetric. Survivor ring: the hub and the ring.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.name: T Bridges
References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.note: M, 15 platforms, choke, outward. King of the hill: the top and bottom crossings are T junctions whose stems drop onto the hill; the rim's high platforms reach them. Each home's remote console raises its middle platform's shortcuts onto the rim. The hill and the T junctions fall first at the Last Stand; the rim survives with the consoles. Point-symmetric.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.name: Fork Delta
References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.note: S, 13 platforms, choke, inward. A Fork junction splits every home's front into two narrow prongs (30 degrees each way) to the pockets, which climb to a switch hub's diagonal platforms (its bridges pick the upper-left and lower-right pair, or the other pair). A back platform over each home reaches the top pocket, and long straights cross to the far side. Point-symmetric. Survivor ring: the hub and its four platforms.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.name: L Loops
References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.note: XS, 9 platforms, choke, inward. Square loops: L corner junctions turn the top and bottom lanes 90 degrees onto the middle platforms, and a switch hub picks the middle platforms or the top and bottom crossings. Point-symmetric. Survivor ring: everything but the homes.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.name: Twin Roundabouts
References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.note: L, 18 platforms, open, inward. Two six-way roundabouts (Junction_Hub6), one in front of each home, share the centre platform: each feeds the home's pockets, the platforms above and below and the centre. The platforms above each roundabout are gates that draw up their spoke and their bridge to the centre. The rim crosses at the top and bottom. At the Last Stand the rim falls; the roundabouts, the centre and the gates fight on. Point-symmetric.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.name: Knot Garden
References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.note: S, 11 platforms, open, inward. A K junction at the centre with its four diagonal bridges to a switch-free ring of platforms; the platforms above-left and below-right are gates that draw up their bridge into the K and their curved bridge (Curve_90) to the next platform. Each home reaches both near platforms. Point-symmetric. Survivor ring: the K and its four platforms.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.name: Trefoil
References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.note: S, 13 platforms, FFA 3, inward. A three-way grinder: a rotor hub (no fixed deck) turns its three bridges between the two triangles of a hexagon of platforms, killing whatever is on them. The hexagon platforms never link each other directly: a pocket between each pair of homes joins two of them, so every road from home to home either crosses the grinder or goes through a pocket two players fight over (both are four bridges). Three-fold symmetric.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.name: Carousel
References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.note: S, 13 platforms, FFA 3, king of the hill, inward. The hill (T4) sits inside a hexagon; three hexagon platforms hold spokes to it, and the other three are switches that turn their hexagon bridge from one neighbour to the other, so the ring round the hill rotates its links. A pocket between each pair of homes joins two hexagon platforms. Three-fold symmetric.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.name: Crossing Three
References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.note: L, 18 platforms, 3v3, inward. Three homes a side. The middle home's front is an X junction feeding both pockets and the middle platform; the centre is a six-way roundabout (Junction_Hub6) fed from the middle platforms and the top platforms, which are gates drawing up their spoke and their bridge to the middle in one go. The survivor ring keeps the lane platforms too, so all six players have producers at the end. Mirrored left / right.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.name: Tri-Roundabout
References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.note: S, 12 platforms, FFA 3, inward. A six-way deck roundabout (Junction_Hub6) in a hexagon of platforms, three homes round it with a pocket between each pair. Every other hexagon platform is a switch: its bridge goes into the roundabout or across to the next platform. Three-fold symmetric.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.name: Round Four
References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.note: L, 21 platforms, FFA 4 and 2v2, inward. The round ring of N-11 (four platforms on curved quarter arcs round a 4-way grinder hub) in the middle of a wide map with a home in every corner: each home's pocket lands on the ring's near side, and a high road crosses the top and bottom edges. Mirrored left / right and top / bottom, so each grinder state is fair on its own (a map turned four ways would swap the two states).

References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.name: Four Corners
References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.note: M, 17 platforms, FFA 4 and 2v2, inward. A home in every corner; the lanes run along the top and bottom and down the sides to a 4-way grinder hub in the middle (a rotor with no fixed deck turning between the middle row and the middle column). In 2v2 the left pair faces the right pair. Mirrored left / right and top / bottom.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.name: Crescent Four
References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.note: L, 19 platforms, FFA 4 and 2v2, outward, king of the hill. N-13 Crescent for four: a home in every corner, each with a remote console one deck away that raises its middle platform's shortcut to the rim. The hill falls first at the Last Stand; the rim with the consoles survives. Mirrored left / right and top / bottom.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.name: Switchyard Three
References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.note: L, 21 platforms, 3v3, inward. Three homes a side on three lanes. Every crossing of the middle is a relay: the top axis platform is a gate that draws up both lane bridges (a gate at the bottom would face the camera, rule G09), and the centre is a switch whose bridge goes up to the gate or down to the bottom crossing. Mirrored left / right.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.name: Serpent Lines
References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.note: L, 19 platforms, 3v3, outward, king of the hill. Three homes a side (N-13's layout for three): the top and bottom homes reach their pockets, which snake up and down to the rim on S-bends of Curve_45s; the rim crosses the map at the top and bottom. The middle home's remote console raises two shortcuts from the middle platform to the rim. The hill falls first at the Last Stand; the rim and the consoles survive. Mirrored left / right.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.name: Star
References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.note: S, 11 platforms, FFA 5, king of the hill, outward. Five homes and five pockets zigzag round a hill (T4) in the middle: every pocket sits between two homes, reaches both and holds a long bridge into the hill. No relays: a five-fold map has no relay spot that is fair to all five seats in both relay states. The hill falls first at the Last Stand; the ring of homes and pockets fights on. Five-fold symmetric. Waivers (Daniele 2026-09-29, Decisions page): L07 - the surviving homes are the finale's production; L05 - no relay works in the finale (the 83 m height leaves no room for one on the ring).

References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.name: Rotor
References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.note: Small, 11 platforms, 1 rotor. The centre is a rotating platform (Forge): its two side decks to the X junctions carry the middle road straight across, or it swings to its deck down to the bottom T, sending the flow onto the bottom lane. Its upper decks to the top platforms stay fixed. Bridges: S pockets, S / M / L, X, T. Inward Last Stand keeps the rotor.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.name: Twin Rotors
References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.note: Mid, 15 platforms, 2 rotors. Each side's middle road meets a rotating platform that either turns it into the centre (a T4) or swings it down onto the bottom lane; its deck back to the top platform stays fixed. The top and bottom lanes cross the axis at T junctions whose stems hold the centre. Bridges: S pockets, S / M / L, T. Inward Last Stand keeps the rotors.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.name: Triple Rotor
References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.note: Large, 17 platforms, 3 rotors. The centre rotor (Forge) carries the middle road straight across or swings it down to the bottom T; its upper decks to the top rotors stay fixed. The top rotors carry the top lane across the axis T or swing down into the middle platforms. Bridges: S pockets, S / M / L, T. Inward Last Stand keeps the centre rotor, outward the top rotors.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.name: Fork Road
References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.note: Small (11 platforms), 1 relay. Each home's road forks (Junction_Fork) to an upper and a lower platform; both reach the centre Forge, whose lower decks are a drawbridge (retract). The pockets run on to the fork's platforms. Bridges: S pockets, S / M / L, Fork. Inward Last Stand keeps the drawbridge.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.name: Crossroads
References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.note: Small (12 platforms), 3 relays. Each home steps onto an X junction that reaches the upper platform, the lower platform and the centre. The centre is a swing (rotation): the two decks to the X junctions (the middle road), or the long deck down to the bottom T, which the gates guard. The lower platforms are gates (retract) on the bottom crossing. Bridges: S pockets, S / M / L, X, T.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.name: Knot
References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.note: Small (11 platforms), 5 relays (relay-heavy). Each home's Y junction reaches the two knot platforms; the knot is a K junction in the middle. The upper knot platforms are gates (retract) into the knot, the lower ones switches (the knot or the bottom T), and the top of the axis is a remote console that cuts both homes' Y roads. Bridges: S pockets, M, Y, K, T.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.name: Causeway
References/Ooze Syndicate maps - lab tes.note: Mid (15 platforms), 1 relay. The middle road is a causeway of T junctions joined by one long junction-to-junction deck; the T stems climb to the top road and drop to the bottom platforms. References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.name: Knot
References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.note: XS, 9 platforms, choke, inward. The axis switch (Forge, review 2026-09-29: was a rotor) holds the map together: its two fixed decks go up to the pockets a / a', and its switched bridges connect either the middle road (m / m', state 1) and the axis platforms above and below (u / w, state 2), so whoever fires it decides whether the middle road crosses. Survivor ring: everything but the homes.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.name: Drawbridge Cross
References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.note: XS, 10 platforms, choke, inward. Both axis platforms are retract relays (review 2026-09-29: the bottom too). The top one: its two bridges down to the left and right pockets are drawbridges (two decks - a commitment), so firing it cuts the top lane in one go and the fight moves through the middle platforms and the bottom axis. Survivor ring: everything but the homes.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.name: Hex Switch
References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.note: M, 15 platforms, open, inward. A hexagon of platforms round a 6-bridge switch hub (Forge): state 1 bridges the bottom centre and the two top sides, state 2 the top centre and the two bottom sides (review 2026-09-29), so every fire moves all three roads into the hub. The hub has no fixed deck; its bridges hold it in every state (a relay hub). Braided pockets outside. Survivor ring: the hub and the hexagon.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.name: Console
References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.note: M, 17 platforms, choke, outward. A king-of-the-hill map: the T4 hill sits on the axis between the two crossings. Each home keeps a remote console (k) one deck away; it raises that side's two shortcuts from the mid platform m up to u and down to w - a home-side console driving a central advantage. The hill falls at the Last Stand; the rim with the consoles and both crossings survives.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.name: Switchyard
References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.note: M, 15 platforms, choke, inward. Two lanes on each side meet a 6-way switch on the axis (fixed decks to m / m', a switched bridge up to the top gate u or down to the bottom gate w). The top and bottom axis platforms are gates now (review 2026-09-29: relays were easy to avoid): each draws up its two lane bridges, and its fixed decks go down to the mid platforms. Every crossing of the axis is a relay.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.name: Ring Road
References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.note: L, 19 platforms, open, inward, 2v2. A ring road runs round the map; teammates share k. The centre is a rotor hub: its pair of bridges turns from the middle road (m / m') to the axis (t / z), and it has no fixed deck. The bottom diagonal platforms beside it are gates (review 2026-09-29: always some risk near the centre): each draws up its bridge into the hub (a gate on the top diagonals would face the camera, rule G09; they keep no bridge into the hub, which leaves the hub's relay button a free 90-degree slot above it, rule G11). Survivor ring: everything inside the ring road.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.name: Rim Run
References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.note: L, 18 platforms, open, both finales. A rim ring round a T4 hill, crossing the axis on top (t) and at the bottom twice (z, y). In the core m is a retract relay: its decks into the hill and up to u retract. On the rim each pocket a is a remote console driving the FAR side's bottom shortcut w'-z (a home-side console, a central advantage). Outward: the rim survives with the consoles; inward: the hill, k / k' and m / m' survive with the retract.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.name: Descent
References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.note: L, 19 platforms, choke, inward, three rings. The homes and pockets fall first, then the middle lanes, leaving the centre. The centre is now a rotor hub with no fixed deck (a meat grinder: its pair turns from the middle road to the axis and back, killing whatever is on it), and the bottom diagonal platforms q are gates drawing up their bridge into the hub (review 2026-09-29: experts dodged the old rotor).

References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.name: Grinder
References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.note: S, 13 platforms, choke, inward. A 6-way meat grinder: a hexagon of platforms round a rotor hub whose three bridges (120 degrees apart) turn 60 degrees every fire - bottom centre + top sides, then top centre + bottom sides - so the hub is always connected and every turn kills whatever is on its bridges (review 2026-09-29; short bridges so the hexagon fits). Two lanes per side feed the hexagon. Survivor ring: the hub and the hexagon.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.name: Hill
References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.note: M, 15 platforms, choke, inward. A T4 hill on the axis. Each side's mid platform m is a retract relay: its deck into the hill and its deck back to the pocket a retract (a commitment on the main road). The top axis platform t is a remote console that raises the mid-to-bottom shortcuts m-w on both sides (a central console driving the approaches). Survivor ring: the hill, the axis platforms, u / w and m / m'.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.name: Round
References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.note: S, 13 platforms, open, inward. A round ring of four platforms on the hub's diagonals, joined by curved quarter arcs, circles a 4-way grinder hub (a rotor with no fixed deck: its pair of bridges turns from one diagonal to the other, killing what is on it). Each home's two pockets land on the ring's near side; a high platform over the top pocket drops onto the ring too. Point-symmetric. Survivor ring: the hub and the ring.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.name: Whirl
References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.note: XS, 9 platforms, open, inward. The smallest ring: four platforms on the hub's diagonals, joined by curved quarter arcs round a switch hub (no fixed deck: its bridges reach one diagonal or the other). Each home sits off the ring's bottom-left platform and swings up to its pocket on a long C-shaped bridge of Curve_45s; the pocket drops onto the ring's top-left platform. Point-symmetric: a whirlpool. Survivor ring: the hub and the ring.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.name: Crescent
References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.note: M, 17 platforms, choke, outward. King of the hill with the hill in the middle between a top and a bottom crossing. Each home keeps a remote console one deck away that raises its side's two shortcuts from the middle platform up and down to the rim (a home-side console, a central advantage). The pockets climb to the rim on curved bridges (Curve_45). The hill falls first at the Last Stand; the rim with the consoles survives. Point-symmetric.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.name: Hooks
References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.note: XS, 9 platforms, choke, inward. A 4-way grinder hub (a rotor with no fixed deck) on the diagonals; each diagonal platform throws a Curve_90 hook back to the home side - the top one to the home, the bottom one to its pocket - and a long straight to the far side's platform. Point-symmetric. Survivor ring: the hub and its four platforms.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.name: Round Table
References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.note: M, 17 platforms, open, inward, 2v2. The round ring of N-11 (four platforms on curved quarter arcs round a 4-way grinder hub) with two homes per side sharing a platform between them; each home's pocket lands on the ring, and a high platform over the top pocket drops onto it too. Point-symmetric. Survivor ring: the hub and the ring.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.name: Galaxy
References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.note: M, 15 platforms, choke, inward. Two spiral arms: from each home a long bridge rises and hooks round (two Curve_45s) into the centre from the side. The centre is a switch whose bridges reach the top and bottom platforms (state 1) or the two diagonal platforms (state 2); the arms are fixed. Each home also has a long deck to the far crossing platform - the second lane. Point-symmetric: the arms read as a two-armed galaxy. Survivor ring: the switch and its four platforms.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.name: Whirlpool
References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.note: M, 17 platforms, open, inward. The round ring (curved quarter arcs round a 4-way grinder hub) inside a full rim: each pocket lands on the ring, a high platform drops onto it too, and the rim crosses the map at the very top and bottom. Point-symmetric. Survivor ring: the hub and the ring.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.name: Side Hairpins
References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.note: M, 15 platforms, choke, inward. Behind each home its two pockets are joined by a wide hairpin (a U of four Curve_45s bulging out at the map's edge - the slow back road). The pockets climb on curved bridges to the rim, which crosses at the top and bottom; the middle is a switch hub whose bridges reach the middle platforms or the rim crossings. Point-symmetric. Survivor ring: the hub, the middle platforms and the crossings.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.name: Knotwork
References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.note: M, 16 platforms, choke, outward. An X junction knots the middle: its four bridges run to the middle platforms and the top and bottom crossings. Each home's remote console raises its side's shortcuts from the middle platform to the rim; the pockets climb to the rim on curved bridges. At the Last Stand the knot falls first and the rim survives with the consoles. Point-symmetric.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.name: S-Bends
References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.note: S, 11 platforms, choke, inward. Every lane is an S-bend: from each home's two pockets a bridge snakes (Curve_45 one way then the other) onto the switch hub's top-left and bottom-left platforms; long straights cross from those to the far side. The pockets behind the home are joined by a hairpin. The hub's bridges pick one diagonal or the other. Point-symmetric. Survivor ring: the hub and its four platforms.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.name: Roundabout
References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.note: L, 20 platforms, open, outward. A six-way deck roundabout (Junction_Hub6) in the middle feeds a hexagon of platforms; the rim runs round it with a crossing at the very top and bottom. The hexagon's west and east platforms are gates: each draws up its spoke into the roundabout and its bridge to the home's middle platform. At the Last Stand the roundabout falls first; the hexagon and the rim fight on round the gates. Point-symmetric.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.name: Hex Gates
References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.note: M, 14 platforms, open, inward. The six-way roundabout (Junction_Hub6) inside a hexagon of platforms; the upper-left and lower-right hexagon platforms are gates that draw up their spoke into the roundabout and their hexagon edge in one go. Each home reaches the hexagon straight and through both pockets. Point-symmetric. Survivor ring: the roundabout and the hexagon.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.name: Crossroads
References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.note: M, 15 platforms, open, inward. The middle lane runs through two X junctions, one each side of a switch hub: every X splits the lane up to a high platform, down to a low one and on into the hub, whose bridges reach the two X junctions or the top and bottom platforms. Point-symmetric. Survivor ring: the hub, the top and bottom platforms and the high / low platforms by the X junctions.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.name: K Crossing
References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.note: L, 18 platforms, choke, outward. A K junction knots the middle: its four diagonal bridges run to the platforms above-left, below-left and their twins. Each home's remote console raises shortcuts from its middle platform up and down to the rim. The K and its platforms fall first at the Last Stand; the rim survives with the consoles. Point-symmetric.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.name: Y Ring
References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.note: S, 13 platforms, choke, inward. The round ring of curved quarter arcs round a 4-way grinder hub (N-11), reached through Y junctions: each home's front bridge splits (60 degrees each way) to both pockets, which land on the ring. Point-symmetric. Survivor ring: the hub and the ring.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.name: T Bridges
References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.note: M, 15 platforms, choke, outward. King of the hill: the top and bottom crossings are T junctions whose stems drop onto the hill; the rim's high platforms reach them. Each home's remote console raises its middle platform's shortcuts onto the rim. The hill and the T junctions fall first at the Last Stand; the rim survives with the consoles. Point-symmetric.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.name: Fork Delta
References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.note: S, 13 platforms, choke, inward. A Fork junction splits every home's front into two narrow prongs (30 degrees each way) to the pockets, which climb to a switch hub's diagonal platforms (its bridges pick the upper-left and lower-right pair, or the other pair). A back platform over each home reaches the top pocket, and long straights cross to the far side. Point-symmetric. Survivor ring: the hub and its four platforms.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.name: L Loops
References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.note: XS, 9 platforms, choke, inward. Square loops: L corner junctions turn the top and bottom lanes 90 degrees onto the middle platforms, and a switch hub picks the middle platforms or the top and bottom crossings. Point-symmetric. Survivor ring: everything but the homes.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.name: Twin Roundabouts
References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.note: L, 18 platforms, open, inward. Two six-way roundabouts (Junction_Hub6), one in front of each home, share the centre platform: each feeds the home's pockets, the platforms above and below and the centre. The platforms above each roundabout are gates that draw up their spoke and their bridge to the centre. The rim crosses at the top and bottom. At the Last Stand the rim falls; the roundabouts, the centre and the gates fight on. Point-symmetric.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.name: Knot Garden
References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.note: S, 11 platforms, open, inward. A K junction at the centre with its four diagonal bridges to a switch-free ring of platforms; the platforms above-left and below-right are gates that draw up their bridge into the K and their curved bridge (Curve_90) to the next platform. Each home reaches both near platforms. Point-symmetric. Survivor ring: the K and its four platforms.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.name: Trefoil
References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.note: S, 13 platforms, FFA 3, inward. A three-way grinder: a rotor hub (no fixed deck) turns its three bridges between the two triangles of a hexagon of platforms, killing whatever is on them. The hexagon platforms never link each other directly: a pocket between each pair of homes joins two of them, so every road from home to home either crosses the grinder or goes through a pocket two players fight over (both are four bridges). Three-fold symmetric.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.name: Carousel
References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.note: S, 13 platforms, FFA 3, king of the hill, inward. The hill (T4) sits inside a hexagon; three hexagon platforms hold spokes to it, and the other three are switches that turn their hexagon bridge from one neighbour to the other, so the ring round the hill rotates its links. A pocket between each pair of homes joins two hexagon platforms. Three-fold symmetric.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.name: Crossing Three
References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.note: L, 18 platforms, 3v3, inward. Three homes a side. The middle home's front is an X junction feeding both pockets and the middle platform; the centre is a six-way roundabout (Junction_Hub6) fed from the middle platforms and the top platforms, which are gates drawing up their spoke and their bridge to the middle in one go. The survivor ring keeps the lane platforms too, so all six players have producers at the end. Mirrored left / right.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.name: Tri-Roundabout
References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.note: S, 12 platforms, FFA 3, inward. A six-way deck roundabout (Junction_Hub6) in a hexagon of platforms, three homes round it with a pocket between each pair. Every other hexagon platform is a switch: its bridge goes into the roundabout or across to the next platform. Three-fold symmetric.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.name: Round Four
References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.note: L, 21 platforms, FFA 4 and 2v2, inward. The round ring of N-11 (four platforms on curved quarter arcs round a 4-way grinder hub) in the middle of a wide map with a home in every corner: each home's pocket lands on the ring's near side, and a high road crosses the top and bottom edges. Mirrored left / right and top / bottom, so each grinder state is fair on its own (a map turned four ways would swap the two states).

References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.name: Four Corners
References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.note: M, 17 platforms, FFA 4 and 2v2, inward. A home in every corner; the lanes run along the top and bottom and down the sides to a 4-way grinder hub in the middle (a rotor with no fixed deck turning between the middle row and the middle column). In 2v2 the left pair faces the right pair. Mirrored left / right and top / bottom.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.name: Crescent Four
References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.note: L, 19 platforms, FFA 4 and 2v2, outward, king of the hill. N-13 Crescent for four: a home in every corner, each with a remote console one deck away that raises its middle platform's shortcut to the rim. The hill falls first at the Last Stand; the rim with the consoles survives. Mirrored left / right and top / bottom.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.name: Switchyard Three
References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.note: L, 21 platforms, 3v3, inward. Three homes a side on three lanes. Every crossing of the middle is a relay: the top axis platform is a gate that draws up both lane bridges (a gate at the bottom would face the camera, rule G09), and the centre is a switch whose bridge goes up to the gate or down to the bottom crossing. Mirrored left / right.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.name: Serpent Lines
References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.note: L, 19 platforms, 3v3, outward, king of the hill. Three homes a side (N-13's layout for three): the top and bottom homes reach their pockets, which snake up and down to the rim on S-bends of Curve_45s; the rim crosses the map at the top and bottom. The middle home's remote console raises two shortcuts from the middle platform to the rim. The hill falls first at the Last Stand; the rim and the consoles survive. Mirrored left / right.

References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.name: Star
References/Ooze Syndicate maps 5.0/json/.note: S, 11 platforms, FFA 5, king of the hill, outward. Five homes and five pockets zigzag round a hill (T4) in the middle: every pocket sits between two homes, reaches both and holds a long bridge into the hill. No relays: a five-fold map has no relay spot that is fair to all five seats in both relay states. The hill falls first at the Last Stand; the ring of homes and pockets fights on. Five-fold symmetric. Waivers (Daniele 2026-09-29, Decisions page): L07 - the surviving homes are the finale's production; L05 - no relay works in the finale (the 83 m height leaves no room for one on the ring).
